links.outcome: LLM extraction accuracy against dual-expert adjudicated ground truth
links.effect: Llama 3.2:3b sensitivity 83.7%, NPV 97.3%; Gemma 2:2b accuracy 86.2%, specificity 88.5%; modest performance on rare findings and limited PPV.
links.quote: Llama 3.2:3b offered superior sensitivity (83.7%) and negative predictive value (NPV) (97.3%), while Gemma 2:2b demonstrated greater overall accuracy (86.2%) and specificity (88.5%).

unlisted_practices: Locally deployed open-weight LLMs for structured data extraction from radiology reports
Few-shot versus zero-shot prompting for report mining

screen.reason: Evaluates the benchmark accuracy of locally deployed open-weight LLMs (Llama 3.2 and Gemma 2) on structured data extraction from PET/CT reports, without testing a specific organizational guardrail or deployment practice.
